highlights.title: Nations League: Promising France defeat Belgium thanks to Olise
highlights.summary: Following their victory in Turkey, France won away at Belgium (1-0). Thanks to this victory, Les Bleus are now at the top of Group A.

highlights.title: More than 80 reported abducted in Nigeria as police find human remains
